title: release the bull
style: Industrial pop with heavy electronic dance music influences. Distorted synth bass pulses in sixteenth notes. A four-on-the-floor kick drum anchors the beat with a crisp snare on the backbeat. Aggressive, processed female vocals deliver rhythmic, staccato lines. High-pitched synth leads provide melodic accents during the chorus. Distorted electric guitar power chords enter during the drop. The tempo is 128 BPM in the key of G minor. Heavy sidechain compression creates a pumping effect between the kick and the synth pads. Industrial sound effects and metallic percussion hits are layered throughout the arrangement.
lyrics:
[Intro]
[distorted synth bass, electronic percussion]

[Verse 1]
[processed female vocals]
Clock is ticking, twenty start deep
The pressure we're applying, waiting for the gift
Back them off the line, hitting at the feet
That's where you want them, wait for the time
I'm anticipating for the lift
Like some kind of animal
Focused, patiently waiting for the perfect opportunity
Remember the first opportunity is not all you got

[Chorus]
[full band enters, heavy synth bass, driving kick]
Focus
Eyes locked, via battle head down
Angled up, firm grip noted
Here it comes, here it comes, here it comes, here it comes
I'm ready, I'm steady, I'm cool
Release the ball
[distorted guitar power chords]
Release the ball
Release the ball
Release the ball

[Bridge]
[drums drop out, ticking clock sound effect]
Clock is ticking, clock is ticking
Clock is ticking, twenty start deep
(Clock is ticking, twenty start deep)

[Chorus]

Focus
Eyes locked, via battle head down
Angled up, firm grip noted
Here it comes, here it comes, here it comes, here it comes
